newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures up, further rise expected.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures up, further rise expected.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed higher across the board on Thursday, supported by the stable dollar and strong metal prices in London, traders said.

Some people are worried as the rebound in London has been too quick. But as long as the G7 does not come up with comments to prop up the yen, buyers should maintain the upper hand," a trader at a major trading house said.
TOCOM aluminium ended 1.8 to 2.2 yen higher, with the benchmark February 1998 contract up 1.8 yen at 209.3 yen per kg. The day's volume was a thin 4,769 lots, down from 5,792 on Wednesday.
Some traders noted individual investors might place more buy orders after squaring positions on Wednesday.

The Tokyo Commodity Exchange plans to hold a news conference later today on the aluminium futures contract that was launched on April 7. Some speculated the exchange might announce measures to lure more investors.
